COMPLETE 13-MODULE ARCHITECTURE

Everything a Fuel Station Needs in One System

Explore our 13 integrated modules below or visit How It Works and User Manual for complete operational details.

🔒 MODULE 01

Hardware-Bound Site Licensing

Each installation is personally activated by Muhammad Rameez Tariq and bound to your station computer so unauthorized copies cannot run on any other PC.

See Installation Process →
📊 MODULE 02

Executive Dashboard & Alerts

Real-time today Diesel/Super/HOBC litres & revenue, red missing-day alerts, top outstanding credit customers, and monthly visual performance charts.

See Daily Check →
📋 MODULE 03 · CORE

3-Part Daily Entry Workspace

Combines Stock Movement & Tanker Receipt panel, Section A (12 Nozzles with Enter-key jump), Section B (Excel Party Debit/Credit Grid), Day Lock, and Thermal Slip print.

Explore 11-Step Routine →
👥 MODULE 04

4-in-1 Unified Accounts System

Manage Customers (with vehicles & credit limits), Expense Heads (EXOV), Employees (EMP1), and Income Heads (MP) in one unified ledger.

View 4 Account Types →
🧾 MODULE 05

SKP-Standard Customer Billing

Generate Rate-Grouped Invoices, Detailed Transaction Statements, or Vehicle-wise Bill Summaries with auto-numbered PM\0101 sequences.

Preview All 3 Bill Formats →
📒 MODULE 06

General & Individual Ledgers

Full double-entry journal search plus instant Individual Account Statement lookup for any Customer, Supplier, Employee, Expense Head, or Income Head.

View Journal Reference →
📦 MODULE 07

Products & PSO Rate Revaluation

Pre-loaded fuels (PD, PS, PH) and lubricants (BLZ1, DEO4, DEO10, T2). Updating prices logs Price History and revalues remaining FIFO stock layers.

See Rate Revision Logic →
🚛 MODULE 08

Suppliers & Tanker Stock Receipts

Record PSO / Hascol tanker deliveries with DO/Invoice voucher numbers. Automatically posts Dr Fuel Stock / Cr Accounts Payable and pushes a FIFO layer.

See Supplier Posting →
👷 MODULE 09

Employee Payroll & Advances

Pay monthly salaries, bonuses, or daily advances either via the dedicated Employees module or directly inside Daily Entry Section B (Dr Salary Expense / Cr Cash).

See Employee Ledger →
💸 MODULE 10

Expenses & Other Income (MP Flow)

Auto-numbered expenses (E001, E002) with back-date filtering. Any entry marked as Income automatically credits the unified MP (Month Profit) account.

See 3-Route MP System →
📈 MODULE 11

11 Financial & Wet Stock Reports

Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, P&L Statement, Income Statement (OIL Gross Profit), Product Stock Statement, Price History, Daily/Monthly Summary, Nozzle Ledger, Wet Stock, and Post Month Profit.

View All 11 Reports →
🔍 MODULES 12 & 13

Data Inspector, Settings & Backup

Inspect all station records in an Excel-style grid, spot missing dates in red, export any table to Excel/CSV, upload your station logo, and export 1-click JSON backups.
